symptom: Matra highlighting inside a word is pixel-column based and therefore CANNOT work for reordering matras — needs replacing with glyph-cluster-aware highlighting
evidence: HIGHEST-LEVERAGE ASK IN THIS BATCH — fleet-wide, every matra lesson. _matraClipCols rasterises the word and colours ink columns after the consonant, so it works for right-spacing matras (ा, ी — both verified correct on नाक and तीर) and CANNOT work for ि, which is typed after its consonant but drawn before it. Measured, not assumed: with ि added to RIGHT_SPACING_MATRAS, दिन mis-clips and the red lands on part of the द — the child is shown the wrong glyph as 'the matra'. Tried, rendered, reverted; see the bundle's engine_local/CHANGES.md. Proper fix: shape the word into per-cluster spans and recolour the matra's cluster, instead of clipping pixel columns. That also unlocks े ै ो ौ ु ू, which all currently fall back to the ◌<matra> callout.
